title: Put your cloud commitment to work: Retool is now on Google Cloud Marketplace
summary: Retool is now on Google Cloud Marketplace. Put committed cloud spend toward Retool, skip new-vendor onboarding, and keep one invoice.
body_markdown:
Retool is now available on[Google Cloud Marketplace (opens in a new tab)](https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/product/retool-public/retool-blueprints) . This means that if your company has a commitment with Google Cloud already, you can bring Retool in through the account you already use, with no new vendor setup and no new budget line.


## What this means for you


Getting Retool through Google Cloud Marketplace puts the budget your company has already committed to work on the tools your teams actually need. Google Cloud counts[eligible Marketplace purchases (opens in a new tab)](https://docs.cloud.google.com/marketplace/docs/commit-drawdown) toward your committed spend.


- **Draw down your existing commitment.** Retool can count toward your committed Google Cloud spend, so you get more out of a commitment your company has already made.
- **Streamline new-vendor onboarding.** Retool comes in through a provider your procurement team has already approved, with a listing reviewed by Google Cloud. That can mean fewer security reviews, vendor forms and approval cycles before your team can start building.
- **One invoice, one relationship.** Retool appears on the cloud invoice your finance team already manages, with no separate vendor account to track.
- **Move faster on budget.** Because the budget is already approved, teams can go from evaluation to building without opening a new budget line.


## How to get Retool on Google Cloud Marketplace


Retool on Google Cloud Marketplace is available through a private offer. Work with your Retool account team to set up an offer based on your plan and needs. Once you accept it in your Google Cloud console, Retool is billed through your Google Cloud account.


## Who should buy Retool through Google Cloud Marketplace?


If your organization has a committed spend agreement with Google Cloud, the marketplace lets you put part of it toward Retool. It's also a natural fit if your procurement team already sends new software through the cloud marketplace to keep vendor management simple, because Retool fits into a process your team already uses.


If you’re a Retool customer coming up on a renewal or planning to expand, talk to your account team about bringing Retool through your cloud marketplace.


## What stays the same for you


Nothing changes for you when you buy through your Google Cloud Marketplace. You get the same platform your teams would get buying directly, so you can build internal apps, agents, workflows and tools on top of your data, APIs and AI models. You also get the same security and governance, including access controls, audit logs, SSO and the rest of the enterprise features your security team expects. And your Retool account team and support stay the same, whichever marketplace you buy through.


## Build with the budget you already have


Your company has already committed budget to the cloud. Now, Retool can be part of it.


[Talk to us](https://retool.com/demo?meeting_page_source=navbarcta) about getting Retool through[Google Cloud Marketplace (opens in a new tab)](https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/product/retool-public/retool-blueprints) .
